hero.h1: Irrigation installation and repair in Greater Victoria
hero.lede: New systems, repairs, spring start-up and fall winterization, with controllers set to match CRD watering days and times.

localContext: Properties on the CRD regional water supply follow Stage 1 lawn watering days from May 1 to September 30, while many rural lots run on private wells instead.
goodFitIf: Your controller has not been checked since it was installed, or you are not sure it matches the CRD lawn watering days.
Some lawn areas are soggy while others turn brown.
You want beds converted from spray heads to drip.
Your strata needs start-up, shutdown and repairs handled for the whole complex, with a zone map on file.

faqs.q: When should I winterize my irrigation system?
faqs.a: Usually in October or early November, before the first hard frost. Read our [irrigation start-up and winterization guide](/resources/irrigation-start-up-and-winterization/).

faqs.q: Does drip irrigation follow the same watering days?
faqs.a: Under CRD Stage 1 rules, drip irrigation of trees, shrubs and gardens is allowed any day; lawn sprinkling has set days and times. Check the current rules on the CRD site.

faqs.q: Can you repair a system someone else installed?
faqs.a: Often, yes. Tell us the make and age of the system and its controller when you request a quote, and we will say whether we can service it.
Tell us about your system when you request a quote and we will let you know what we can do: [CERTIFICATIONS].

faqs.q: How do you set a controller for the watering rules?
faqs.a: On the regional water supply, lawn zones go on the CRD lawn days and times for your address, and drip zones are set separately. A strata uses the complex's street address. The [CRD watering rules guide](/resources/crd-watering-rules-guide/) has the schedule and the official link.

faqs.q: We are on a private well. Does the CRD schedule apply?
faqs.a: The CRD schedule covers properties connected to its water systems, so a property on a private well is not on it. The Province still asks well owners to conserve water year-round, so ask us about zones and run times that suit what your well can supply.
